bottleneck.description: Smart-home / consumer SwitchBot brand with a nascent humanoid (Onero H1) launched Q1 2026; competes with Roborock, Ecovacs, Dreame in consumer robotics — no critical-input role.

dependency.key_customers: Direct-to-consumer (Amazon, retail across 90+ countries); Apple/Google/Amazon smart-home ecosystem integrations
dependency.key_suppliers: Chinese consumer electronics supply chain (BLE/Wi-Fi SoCs, brushless motors, lithium cells, plastic injection)

editorial.notes: Newly IPO'd (Dec 2025) consumer smart-home company best known for SwitchBot accessories, now extending into humanoid housekeepers. Operates in a hyper-competitive consumer electronics market with low switching costs and many peer brands. Despite 90-country distribution and 3.6M households served, products are discretionary consumer goods, not industrial inputs. Onero H1 is unproven at scale and ships into the same crowded humanoid consumer field. Clearly LOW.
